notes.title: Release notes v0.7.6.2
notes.notes:
OK, this update should be quite good!

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed “Maximum” word in Russian to move all the tile info texts.
- Fixed missing temperature measurement visualization.
- Fixed bug with water and air humidity transition.
- Fixed bug causing meteors to remove water from the planet little by little.
- Improved water simulation to avoid crazy shoreline movements.
- Fixed flower and fruit duplication glitch in the same plant.
- Fixed creature feather color to being too dark.

notes.title: Release notes v0.7.6.0
notes.notes: [p]By popular request, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian have been added to the game![/p][p]I have also made multiple improvements and fixes based on suggestions and bug reports.[/p][p]After this update, I will focus on the Civilizations update, releasing only minor patches to fix any critical bugs.[/p][p]The plan is to release a major update with the Civilization's Early Ages, gather player feedback, make fixes and changes, and when the Civilizations implementation looks good, release another update including the Modern Ages.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Brazilian Portuguese translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Russian translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added temperature scale selector between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.[/p][/*][*][p]Added key binding menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added shortcuts to open all main menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Added taxonomy for plants and fungi names.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, you can switch views using TAB.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trees will only be completely devoured by huge creatures (other creatures can eat trees, but they will not destroy them).[/p][/*][*][p]Tiny creatures will not destroy plants when they eat them.[/p][/*][*][p]Volcanoes generate CO2 now.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug in water movement simulation that was making the sea not be leveled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug allowing to delete components that are dependencies of others, allowing an exploit for unexpected combinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water and terrain borders forming strange shapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bad elevation positioning of elements in the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing exoskeleton to be excluded from random mutations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed star system configuration preview not showing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fins positioning wrong, specially after devolve from legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved grass pop-up in walking camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Steam connection errors.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release note v0.7.5.0
notes.notes:
[p][b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed some rendering issues with creature skin.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Improved feather skin.
- Showing fungi population in the planet zoom.
- Now you can export creatures from the editor.
- Added import/export systems for plants.
- Added possibility to rename plants.
- Added import/export systems for fungi.
- Added possibility to rename fungi.
- Added button, in the import screen, to open the Window’s creature/plant/fungi cards folder.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Developer notes[/b][/p][p]After this release, I need time to plan and introduce the next features, so next updates won't be just focused on bug fixing but also about adding more content.[/p][p]Because of this, the pace of daily new patches will slow down a bit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/50be9d38cd8a615a8ad071e198538af82b006147.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/8c435cea468142cd2bcf6af47325997a4920103e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo update v0.7.4.7
notes.notes: [p]The demo has received a huge update to match the current state of art of the main game.[/p][p][/p][p]This was done because the old demo was too outdated including performance issues, bugs and glitches that will not representing well the actual state of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The new demo is closer to the current game. [/p][p][/p][p]However, compared to the old demo, few things new were added but some others were removed such as the option to play the unlimited mode.[/p][p][/p][p]On the other hand, you can expect similar experience with limited amount of components, tools, task and also doesn't include a save/load system.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update v0.5.7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Here a new update of Planetary Life demo, and this time yes! This will be the last one unless I have to do some hot fixes related to bugs or balancing.

No more new features, no more additions until the game gets released :-)

In this new update you will find the following:

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added “Observer” option. This mode is ideal to leave the game running automatically. Instead of stay in a fixed point because of the inaction of the player, it will move the camera automatically focusing on major events. This option is ideal for long run streaming as well.
[*] In screen stand-alone message for most recent notification.
[*] Added individual mutation rate parameter for plants.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Now vegetarians will eat plants and reduce the amount them, with a possibility of remove all vegetation in the area.
[*] Nutritional values of plants affect the hungry levels of creatures.
[*] Moved a bit away the planet’s ring to avoid being to close to the global camera.
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed bug applying wrong texture to creature’s sprite animation.
[*] Fixed bug causing wild fire events to spawn in areas with no vegetation or water.
[/list]

Also, here a summary of most important changes between version 0.5.0 and this update (ignoring previously mentioned changes, bug fixed and other minor stuff):
[list]
[*] Changed how evolution menu works: now you can do many changes, but each change will have a cost. At the end, the price of all changes will be subtracted from your energy.
[*] Added “undo last change” button to creature/plant editor to undo step by step all done changes and also to avoid players getting stuck.
[*] Improved rain effect.
[*] Mutated creatures will have a 25% chance to get adapted their temperature to the new location.
[*] Improved atmosphere, showing a bluer sky and stars at night.
[*] Now mutation rate artifact can change to decreasing the rate.
[*] Now reproduction rate artifact can change to decreasing the rate.
[*] Added artifact to change humidity in the area.
[*] Added mouth noises to creatures.
[*] Added proper omnivore, carnivore and vegetarian separated plots for Stats screen.
[/list]

ENJOY the demo!!! 
And see you soon when the game gets released in Early Access!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.0

This is the last demo before the game gets released in Early Access!

I will only do updates on this demo to fix big issues.
This means... the release of the game is coming!

However, the release date is still undefined, but we can start saying is coming soon! 🎉 🎉 🎉

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added current creatures and plants catalog menu.
[*] Added creatures and plants evolution tree screens.
[*] Added corpses on dead creature’s locations.
[*] Added new creature view menu to show more details.

[*] Added new lifeform creation menu, to get adapted to the new Cell Stage (not available in this demo).

[*] Improved game performance when using the walking camera.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
I know it's been a while, I'm sorry!

But it's for a good reason... a new rendering system!

What that means? Well... I added a new camera to the game that allow players to [b]walk and explore planet's surface[/b]! 
Because of this, I needed to rebuild the whole rendering system of the game, and also redo many of the assets, because initially were designed for a top-down view but now you can watch them from any angle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/c9c230420e6d5ae9966da0217ca3f47bdeed83bd.png[/img]

Also, I fully implement the vegetation system including allowing the players to evolve them and generate procedural plants and trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/fbc353cd121544a610b34a6e49461861afb4e30e.png[/img]

Along with this demo, there are many other changes and improvements, but I will summary them in the following release note.

I hope you enjoy this new version of the demo!

[i]I promise that the next version will be released sooner![/i]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] New zoom adding walking level camera.
[*] New global minimap.
[*] New procedural plants.
[*] Added soil moisture.
[*] Added skeletons to creatures.
[*] Added multiple sizes to creatures.
[*] Added tile history menu. This will keep a log of what happened in the tile in the past.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fully changed planet mesh rendering.
[*] Removed evolution energy resource. Now everything works with cosmic energy.
[*] New diet system for creatures based on preferences.
[*] Added microorganism diet.
[*] Now, in evolution menu, when evolving a component the reverts are shown in the same menu.
[*] Improved objects positioning in terrain surface.
[*] Improved air humidity system.
[*] Improved creature’s leg movement.
[*] Improved messages and hit points visualization.
[*] New fighting animation for creatures.
[*] Reduced ring rotation and added shadow projection.
[*] Improved notifications menu.
[*] The creature evolve notification will show only once when the first evolution happens.
[*] An alert has been added to notify the time is paused.
[*] Now natural volcanoes will appear in fixed positions along continental plates boundaries.
[*] New skill tree based on gameplay progression.
[*] Simplified planet colors avoiding non-natural colors.
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed showing white square instead of proper sprite on creatures.
[*] Fixed bug allowing to change camerazoom when evolution menus were open.
[*] Fixed fertile terrain requirements.
[*] Fixed time non resuming after some situations that were pausing it.
[*] Fixed bug allow to zoom to early during camera tutorial.
[*] Fixed blurry skill tree screen.
[/list]
